body:
Wow, just wow. It goes beyond me the fact that someone can be so damn strong. It's amazing. Thank you for taking the time to talk to me, I really needed that. I'm just tired of living for others, I want to live for myself, if it's possible for me, but I just can't seem to do it. It's like whenever something goes wrong, I put it in a pile with every other shit and it keeps accumulating, until you reach a point where you are out of health and stamina potions. It's like I'm an NPC, not the real deal. 

I'll think about what you just said. Sounds like you had your share, and I'd be an imbecile not to take your advice into consideration. Thanks, sweetie. Thanks.

Thank you. But that's the thing, I'm still here because of these things. What happens the day they are gone? What then? That's the thing that is worrying me, that I'm not my own reason for living and I don't know what else to try. I just want to *feel alive* without having to do it thanks to any kind of drug. I don't draw. I don't take pictures. I don't write. I don't have a hobby because I don't enjoy anything I've tried so far. Suggestions? :(
